notes.title: Update 1.4 Released
notes.content:
* Fixed first person collision system. Objects won't get you hopping into the air anymore.

* Complete overhaul of world colliders.

* Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the telescopes when you're interacting with them the second time.

* Added a new small secret towards the very end of the game. It doesn't count as an achievement or game completion.

* Added "Mouse Invert Y Axis" option  into the Options Menu. A special thanks to "Ruby Bliels" for that.
